title: Sony STR DE197 2 Channel 100 Watt Receiver Tested Works With Remote Bundle
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:TV, Video & Home Audio:Home Audio:Receivers & Amplifiers:Receivers
descriptionText: This Sony STR-DE197 stereo receiver is a high-quality device that offers a digital tuner and a headphone jack. With two channels and a power output of 100 watts, it is perfect for enhancing your home audio experience. The receiver has a single input and is compatible with a variety of devices, making it a versatile addition to your home entertainment setup. Its brand, Sony, is known for producing excellent audio equipment, and this model is no exception. Whether you're watching TV or listening to your favorite music, this receiver is sure to impress.
